points.label: Means and human consequence
points.left: The scene includes sin, lawlessness, and manifestation. It also includes the devil, sinning from the beginning, and God’s seed. It also includes children, love, and Cain. It also includes the evil one, murder, and deeds. Together, these details form the contrast.
points.right: The scene includes shared flesh and blood, death, and the devil. It also includes slavery through fear, Abraham’s offspring, and merciful priesthood. It also includes atonement, suffering, and temptation. It also includes help. Together, these details are linked in the passage.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Through death Jesus brings to nothing the one holding death’s power

payload.tension: Both describe what the Son destroys. One centers on sin and the devil’s works; the other on death, fear, and help.
payload.title: The Son destroys the devil’s works and power of death
